verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly publish a public data API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and no pages were fetched. There is therefore no evidence of published endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits. Confidence is low because the absence reflects blocked access rather than a confirmed lack of an API.
